title: Find an average
summary: MATLAB: Find an average. Find the mean of [4 6 8].
introduction: mean returns the average. For this row it adds three numbers and divides by three.

blocks.text: Use MATLAB. Paste one example into the Command Window, or save it as a .m script and run the script. A MATLAB licence may be required.
The row sum is 12. mean divides it by the three values.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: For a matrix, check which dimension mean works along.
